title: System Identification under Noise and Attack Regimes: Agnostic and Composite Robustness
summary: Dynamical systems often confront persistent zero-mean independent noise and/or sparse nonzero-mean adversarial attacks. While mean-based estimators like least-squares handle the former, the median-based $\ell_1$-norm estimator is effective for the latter. In this paper, we develop robust system identification frameworks to identify a linearly-parametrized nonlinear system from a single trajectory of length $T$.
